#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct FastScanner {
    std::istream& in;
    std::vector<char> buffer;
    size_t ptr, buflen;

    FastScanner() : in(std::cin), buffer(1024), ptr(0), buflen(0) {}

    bool hasNextByte() {
        if (ptr < buflen) return true;
        ptr = 0;
        buflen = in.readsome(buffer.data(), buffer.size());
        return buflen > 0;
    }

    int readByte() {
        return hasNextByte() ? static_cast<unsigned char>(buffer[ptr++]) : -1;
    }

    static bool isPrintableChar(char c) {
        return c > 32 || c < 0;
    }

    static bool isNumber(char c) {
        return '0' <= c && c <= '9';
    }

    bool hasNext() {
        while (hasNextByte() && !isPrintableChar(buffer[ptr])) ptr++;
        return hasNextByte();
    }

    std::string next() {
        if (!hasNext()) throw std::out_of_range("No next element");
        std::string sb;
        char b;
        while (isPrintableChar(b = readByte())) sb.push_back(b);
        return sb;
    }

    long long nextLong() {
        if (!hasNext()) throw std::out_of_range("No next element");
        long long n = 0;
        bool negative = false;
        char b = readByte();
        if (b == '-') {
            negative = true;
            b = readByte();
        }
        if (!isNumber(b)) throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid number");
        do {
            n = n * 10 + (b - '0');
        } while (isNumber(b = readByte()));
        return negative ? -n : n;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return static_cast<int>(nextLong());
    }

    double nextDouble() {
        return std::stod(next());
    }
};

namespace Arrays {
    void sort(std::vector<int>& array) {
        std::sort(array.begin(), array.end());
    }
    void sort(std::vector<long long>& array) {
        std::sort(array.begin(), array.end());
    }
}

namespace IntMath {
    int gcd(int a, int b) {
        while (a != 0) {
            int t = b % a;
            b = a;
            a = t;
        }
        return b;
    }

    long long gcd(long long a, long long b) {
        while (a != 0) {
            long long t = b % a;
            b = a;
            a = t;
        }
        return b;
    }

    long long lcm(long long a, long long b) {
        return a / gcd(a, b) * b;
    }

    int pow(int a, int b) {
        int ans = 1;
        int mul = a;
        for (; b > 0; b >>= 1, mul *= mul) {
            if (b & 1) ans *= mul;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    int pow(int a, int b, int mod) {
        if (b < 0) b = b % (mod - 1) + (mod - 1);
        long long ans = 1;
        long long mul = a;
        for (; b > 0; b >>= 1, mul = (mul * mul) % mod) {
            if (b & 1) ans = (ans * mul) % mod;
        }
        return static_cast<int>(ans);
    }

    int floorsqrt(long long n) {
        return static_cast<int>(std::sqrt(n + 0.1));
    }

    int ceilsqrt(long long n) {
        return n <= 1 ? static_cast<int>(n) : static_cast<int>(std::sqrt(n - 0.1)) + 1;
    }
}

int main() {
    FastScanner fs;
    int n = fs.nextInt();
    long long k = fs.nextLong();
    const int MOD = 998244353;
    std::vector<long long> fact(n + 1, 1), inv(n + 1, 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        fact[i + 1] = fact[i] * (i + 1) % MOD;
    }
    inv[n] = IntMath::pow((int)fact[n], MOD - 2, MOD);
    for (int i = n; i > 0; --i) {
        inv[i - 1] = inv[i] * i % MOD;
    }

    auto comb = [&](int i, int j) -> long long {
        if (j < 0 || j > i) return 0;
        return fact[i] * inv[j] % MOD * inv[i - j] % MOD;
    };

    std::cout << (k == 0 ? fact[n] : (k > n ? 0 : []() {
        int k2 = static_cast<int>(k);
        int k3 = n - k2;
        long long ans = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= k3; ++i) {
            long long tmp = comb(k3, i) * IntMath::pow(i, n, MOD) % MOD;
            if (((k3 - i) & 1) != 0) {
                ans -= tmp;
            } else {
                ans += tmp;
            }
        }
        ans = (ans % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
        ans = ans * 2 % MOD * comb(n, k2) % MOD;
        return ans;
    }()) ) << "\n";

    return 0;
}
